compilerImplementation.scope: Candidate bootstraps the maintained compiler through the existing encoder/runtime/SDK controller; this does not independently qualify the new language semantics.

independentEncoder.normalization: Only spacing surrounding let/set assignment equals, anchored at source lines. Native and encoder consume identical normalized bytes. No oracle source modification.

selfGeneration.scope: Compiler implementation subset and native fixed point. Neither independently implements new owned-field language semantics.

fixedFindings: Scalar expressions initially queried record metadata for type zero; guard corrected.
Property-kind condition initially used non-normalized bitwise truth and mishandled even type tags; corrected.
Moved-out field property reads were admitted and trapped; now refused at compile time.
The labelled-batch app now accepts empty readings without changing the shared statistics library contract.
faultScope: Controlled syscall-result patches and descriptor-address observation in owned disposable test binaries, not actual host OOM/kernel errors or a source-level pointer API.
limits: Apple Silicon Mac isolated candidate, no stable compiler/package replacement.
Text stores validated Unicode scalars in u64 cells; no grapheme, normalization or compact-storage claim.
Local aggregate/field moves only; no owner return/transfer parameter, owned nested aggregates, generic collection elements or concurrency proof.
Cleanup applies to ordinary returns; fatal traps, signals, trusted raw effects and persistent kernel retirement refusal remain outside infallible cleanup guarantees.
No performance, token, hardware, independent reviewer or universal language-safety claim.
